# GIF Compress

> Free online GIF compression tools, processed in your browser, nothing uploaded. Reduce animated GIF file size by up to 70% without quality loss.

## Tools
- [GIF Compressor](https://www.gifcompressors.com/compress-gif/): Reduce animated GIF size by up to 70% with no quality loss. Three modes: Quality, Balanced, Maximum.
- [GIF Optimizer](https://www.gifcompressors.com/gif-optimizer/): Advanced compression engine with per-parameter control over colors, frames, and encoding.
- [Reduce GIF Size](https://www.gifcompressors.com/reduce-gif-size/): Platform-specific compression targets for Discord, Twitter, email, and websites.
- [GIF to MP4](https://www.gifcompressors.com/gif-to-mp4/): Convert animated GIF to MP4 video. 80-95% file size reduction.
- [GIF to WebP](https://www.gifcompressors.com/gif-to-webp/): Convert GIF to WebP format. 60-90% smaller with full alpha transparency.
- [Resize GIF](https://www.gifcompressors.com/resize-gif/): Change GIF dimensions online, scale by percentage, or set exact width and height.
- [Crop GIF](https://www.gifcompressors.com/crop-gif/): Trim animated GIF edges, set custom aspect ratios.

## Guides
- [How GIF Compression Works](https://www.gifcompressors.com/blog/how-gif-compression-works/): Technical deep-dive into color reduction, frame optimization, and LZW encoding.
- [Batch Compress GIFs](https://www.gifcompressors.com/blog/batch-compress-gifs-guide/): Save hours with our batch compression workflow.
- [GIF vs WebP vs MP4](https://www.gifcompressors.com/blog/gif-vs-webp-vs-mp4/): Complete format comparison with benchmarks.
- [Why GIF Files Are So Large](https://www.gifcompressors.com/blog/why-gif-files-are-so-large/): Understanding the 1987 format that refuses to die.
- [GIF Compression for Social Media](https://www.gifcompressors.com/blog/gif-compression-for-social-media/): Complete guide for Discord, Twitter, and more.

## Key Features
- 100% client-side processing, files never uploaded to any server
- Real-time preview with before/after comparison slider
- Platform presets for Discord (8MB), Twitter (5MB), email (1MB)
- Batch processing with ZIP download
- Powered by gifsicle 1.92 via WebAssembly
